signal: Runner verified receipt, entry and DNA JSON but reopened mutable files through shutil.copyfile; concurrent mutation could make published proof differ from validated content while status reported PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED.
root_cause: Time-of-check/time-of-use race between evidence validation and proof copying; only raw_snapshot bytes were previously retained.
upstream_downstream: Any concurrent writer or file modification after validation can corrupt proof bytes; downstream artifact consumers may trust a successful status and inconsistent copied files.
severity: P1 evidence integrity; not an observed production event
hypothesis: Retaining the exact receipt, entry and DNA bytes at validation and writing those bytes directly to proof prevents the reproduced post-validation copy race.

baseline.raw_pytest: 3 failed, 359 passed, 3 skipped, 3 warnings, 54 subtests passed
baseline.note: Offline synthetic mutation; no broker access or cloud runtime

repair.scope: Use once-read validated bytes for receipt, entry and DNA proof; raw_snapshot already used captured bytes.
repair.rollback: Governed revert of isolated commit, preserving negative test evidence and no force push.

regression.mechanism: Patch shutil.copyfile to mutate each file at the copy boundary; proof must contain the bytes emitted by child and validated, with PAPER_RECEIPT_VERIFIED status.
regression.safety: No network, secrets, broker calls or real orders.

after_ci: See final exact-head GitHub Actions run and Issue #3 addendum; not claimed by this record.
next_session_recurrence_check: Re-run the negative copy-race regression at exact head and inspect real cloud proof artifact bytes and SHA when authorized deployment exists.
reopen_if: Any verified proof differs from its validated receipt/entry/DNA bytes or stale/corrupted proof is published as successful.
